structured_output.summary: MATCHING/tgt_lost_links.do is clean and ready to run, with no defects found across correctness, claims-vs-code, replication, or identification. All merges, sample partitions, two-sided truth classifications (V/U/C), and net link-accounting identities are exact and guarded by assertions against MATCHING/score_tgt_links.do. Tracing abematch.ado and the divided birthplace files confirms that the person-level uniqueness assertions (isid histid1930 and isid histid1940) are guaranteed to hold on the ABE link outputs.

verified_clean.evidence: In MATCHING/tgt_lost_links.do:56-59, 1940 records in `samp` (unique on `histid` at line 34, with `target` strictly 0/1 as confirmed by `assert N_restr + N_non == N_full` in MATCHING/score_tgt_links.do:270 and MATCHING/score_tgt_links.log:375,389) are classified into `grp` = 0 (non-target), 1 (target), or 2 (`_merge==1`, outside the 51.0M sample). Non-target pair counts are asserted against `score_tgt_links.do` at lines 84-85 (`10363116` for `old`, `10238786` for `tgt`).
verified_clean.item: 1940 group partitioning (`grp`) and non-target link count gates against `score_tgt_links.do`

verified_clean.evidence: In MATCHING/tgt_lost_links.do:64-80, `cls` assigns 2 (unverifiable) when `m30==1 & m40==1`, 1 (verified) when `m40==3 & t30==h30`, and 3 (contradicted) when `(m40==3 & t30!=h30) | (m40==1 & m30==3)`, followed by `assert !missing(cls)`. For all in-sample 1940 records (`grp` in {0,1}), matching against unrestricted `by40` (`truth`) is identical to matching against `true_by1940` in MATCHING/score_tgt_links.do:160-163,187-195; for `to_outside` records (`ngrp==2`), using unrestricted `by40` avoids misclassifying a true outside-sample link as contradicted via `m40==1 & m30==3`.
verified_clean.item: Two-sided V/U/C truth classification (`cls` and `ncls`) across in-sample and outside-sample links

verified_clean.evidence: Within each birthplace file, C:/Program Files (x86)/Stata15/ado/base/a/abematch.ado:592-595,836-839,956,983,992 enforces 1-to-1 matching on both `ID_A` and `ID_B` via `merge 1:1`. Across birthplace files (`norace*.dta`), `histid` is disjoint on both the 1930 and 1940 sides (proven by `isid histid` after appending all birthplace files in MATCHING/score_tgt_links.log:311,568), and MATCHING/3_append_and_clean_all_links_christian_torbenV2.do appends each birthplace at most once (0 duplicate pairs in MATCHING/score_tgt_links.log:661,679). Thus `isid histid1930` and `isid histid1940` at MATCHING/tgt_lost_links.do:90-91 cannot fail on valid ABE outputs.
verified_clean.item: Person-level uniqueness assertions (`isid histid1930` and `isid histid1940`) on deduplicated `fiveyr_band==1` ABE pairs

Because `(histid1930, histid1940)` is absent from the other version after filtering to `still==1` (or `was==1`), any match on `histid1930` (`a_linked==3` or `a_old==3`) is guaranteed to be to a different 1940 partner (`n40 != histid1940`), and `assert `ngain' - `nlost' == 10238786 - 10363116` at line 146 verifies the net difference.

summary.description: Two to four sentences. The overall state of the reviewed work and the single most important thing to fix. No preamble.

dimensions_reviewed.description: Which scope dimensions were actually reviewed in this run.

findings.description: Defects and concerns, ordered most severe first. Empty if none. Do not pad with stylistic observations.

severity.description: blocker: a reported result is wrong. major: a referee would demand it. minor: real but survivable. nit: cosmetic.

confidence.description: verified: traced in the source. likely: strongly implied but depends on unseen data. speculative: a question, not an established defect.

title.description: One line, stating the defect itself, not its category.

location.description: path:line, or path:line-line. Several may be comma-separated. Required: a finding without a location is not a finding.

what_the_code_does.description: Precisely what the code computes, quoting the relevant expression. Contrast with what it was evidently intended to compute.

why_it_matters.description: The consequence for a number or claim in the paper. If there is no consequence, the severity is nit.

how_to_check.description: A concrete command, tabulation, or count the author can run to confirm or refute this in minutes.

suggested_fix.description: The change, specific enough to act on. Do not apply it yourself.

verified_clean.description: Things explicitly checked that were fine. This is what makes a short findings list trustworthy rather than lazy.

evidence.description: How it was confirmed, with path:line where applicable.

review_limits.description: What this review could NOT establish: data not readable, pipeline not runnable, paper text unavailable, Stata semantics not verifiable by reading. Be explicit; silence here reads as false assurance.
